Label: Blank role
Summary: Create a blank role requirement for process-specific staffing.

Label: Product owner
Summary: Outcome and acceptance owner for value, scope, sequencing, and release acceptance.

Label: Delivery manager
Summary: Flow owner for sequencing, staffing realism, dependency control, and execution escalation.

Label: Solution architect
Summary: Architecture authority for system boundaries, irreversible decisions, and cross-domain technical coherence.

Label: Lead engineer
Summary: Implementation owner for code, tests, migration notes, and reviewable delivery proof.

Label: QA lead
Summary: Quality owner for coverage depth, evidence quality, and release confidence.

Label: Security reviewer
Summary: Security gate owner for threat assessment, exception handling, and trust-boundary decisions.

Label: Release manager
Summary: Operational owner for release window control, rollback readiness, and live-watch discipline.

Label: Review lead
Summary: Governed reviewer who owns code-review lane selection, normalization, and escalation discipline.

Label: Author
Summary: Change author responsible for preparing a reviewable packet and implementing requested repairs.

Label: Merge approver
Summary: Go / no-go owner for merging reviewed changes into the governed integration branch.

Label: Account owner
Summary: Commercial owner for onboarding priority, stakeholder alignment, and acceptance timing.

Label: Staffing manager
Summary: Capacity and staffing authority for onboarding sequencing, specialist allocation, and kickoff feasibility.

Label: Kickoff lead
Summary: Meeting and execution lead for the formal onboarding kickoff and first-phase alignment.

Label: Triage lead
Summary: Initial incident coordinator for severity framing, responder mobilization, and first containment path selection.

Label: Resolver
Summary: Primary technical owner for diagnosis, mitigation, and restoration work inside an active incident.

Label: Approver
Summary: Explicit governance decision owner for escalated incident actions, risky mitigations, or customer-impacting restoration choices.
